svg.title: AI factory on one VM: fabric, kind, BNK, Polaris, simulators, agents, guardrails
svg.text: AI factory on one VM: containerlab fabric, kind, BNK 2.4.2, Polaris, NVIDIA simulators, agents, CalypsoAI
Instruqt VM n2-standard-32, image f5/aibnk · numbered circles = the chapter that looks there (docs/storyline.md)
VM: docker, containerlab 0.75, kind v1.30.13, registry mirrors (/var/lib/bnk-mirrors), ollama (qwen2.5:1.5b on CPU)
FRR EVPN fabric (quay.io/frrouting/frr:10.6.2), configs from fabric/gen.py
VRFs on leaves and border1: external (L3VNI 10000), tenant-a/b/c (10001-10003), RT 65000:<vni>
leaf1 eth3 -> bnk-worker eth1: untagged 172.16.10.0/24 (TMM .11, leaf .1 as AS 65000) + VLAN 101-103 (172.17.10x.0/24)
r5 gives every VRF a default and takes the VIP pools and tenant SNAT pools back; the client stands in for the internet
kind cluster bnk (Calico, feature gates for Substrate): bnk-control-plane · bnk-worker (app=f5-tmm) · bnk-worker2 (workload=ai, fake H100s)
BNK 2.4.2 host mode (f5-bnk): TMM on bnk-worker, 2 Gi hugepages · OcNOS BGP AS 65100 to leaf1 · legacy network model (Vrf, RoutingConfig) · F5BnkGateway VIP pool 172.16.100.10-29
kagent Agent assistant · own AI Gateway key
OpenShell sandbox: key injected only toward 172.16.100.2x
kagent Agent assistant · own AI Gateway key
OpenShell sandbox: key injected only toward 172.16.100.2x
MCP server: experiments + the shadow agent
kagent Agent assistant · own AI Gateway key
OpenShell sandbox: key injected only toward 172.16.100.2x
kagent 0.10.4 (UI :30808, k8s tool server read-only) · operator agent factory-operator · NVIDIA OpenShell 0.1.5 gateway + Agent Sandbox v1.0.7 · Agent Substrate v0.0.11
model for every agent: qwen2.5-1.5b on ollama (CPU, on the VM), reached only through the Polaris AI Gateway
controls in order: Polaris identity (virtual key per principal) -> CalypsoAI content scan in TMM -> OpenShell network policy -> BNK egress in the tenant VRF
Guardrails in the data path (guardrails namespace)
request -> TMM (tenant-c-ai listener) -> iRule: Content-Length checks, collect body -> sideband POST /backend/v1/scans -> verdict -> block (X-Guardrail: blocked, model never sees it) or release
scanner = mock-calypso (always; MRN / ID / card shapes, exfiltration verbs) or calypso-bridge -> real CalypsoAI project AI-Instruqt (token in the bridge, never in the iRule)
attached by the learner: NetPolicy guardrails-tenant-c (extensionRefs F5BigCneIrule guardrails, targetRefs Gateway tenant-c-ai)
where the webhook dies: OpenShell refuses the socket inside a sandbox; outside one, the packet enters VRF tenant-c and the firewall ACL has no rule for it; tcpdump on border1 shows nothing
on the record: Polaris console (who, key, model, tenant), Prometheus, TMM log, OpenShell audit
docs/storyline.md for the chapters · install/*.sh in order 00, 05, 10, 20, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60 · re-run this script to redraw
